name: Maximillian Hardwich
source:
Louise's father.

[spoiler]In the ending, it's revealed that he had fallen in love with Therese, Kia's mother who faked her death. The two of them carefully planned out all of Louise and Kia's requests together, all with the intention of teaching them how to live a good life despite their circumstances.[/spoiler]
